identity.name: Llama3.1-Flammades-70B
identity.summary: A text-generation model produced by ORPO tuning on two H100 GPUs for three epochs.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only architecture, tuning method, and hardware; no training data, evaluation, or intended-use details are stated.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not describe how the ORPO tuning data was collected, curated, or used, so training-data documentation is missing.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card lists only 'Text Generation' as primary task and gives no intended or prohibited uses, leaving downstream risk scope undefined.

specifications.model_size: 131.4 GiB of safetensors weights (141,107,497,872 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was tuned with ORPO for 3 epochs on 2x H100 hardware.
